tools.name: waist_check
tools.description: Use this when an adult asks how their waist measurement compares with the suggested range for fitness, such as "is 36 inch waist too big for a man", "waist 88 cm woman", "waist to height ratio 92 cm 170 cm" or "recommended waist size for Indians". Do not use for children, pregnancy, or medical, trea

tools.name: waist_target
tools.description: Use this when an adult asks what waist size to aim for at their height for a fitness goal, such as "waist size for 5 ft 8 man", "ideal waist for 160 cm woman" or "what should my waist be". Gives half your height and the suggested Indian range limit. Do not use for children, pregnancy, or medical que

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "waist_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
